description: Verifies a keccak256 Merkle proof. leaf, root and every proof entry must be 0x 32-byte hashes (hash_leaf:true keccak-hashes a raw leaf first). sorted:true (default) is OpenZeppelin MerkleProof (sorted pairs); sorted:false needs leaf_index or positions to order each pair. Up to 256 proof entries. Price: $0.01 USDC per call on Base mainnet ($0.001 on Base Sepolia), paid with x402; failed calls are not charged.

hash_leaf.description: keccak256 the leaf before verifying (default false).

leaf.description: 0x 32-byte leaf hash (or raw data with hash_leaf:true).

positions.description: For sorted:false: the side of each sibling.

proof.description: Sibling hashes from leaf to root.

name: merkle.verify
title: Verify a Merkle proof
